title: {Syn} Speculative Decoding Speeds Up Generation With a Draft Model
content:
Speculative decoding uses a smaller draft model to propose tokens and a larger model to verify them. Accepted drafts let the system produce multiple tokens per expensive step.

The method is useful because inference latency matters as much as training scale when models are used interactively.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
